objects.description: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has run netstat -anp to search for rival malware connections.(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT) [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has also used `libprocesshider` to modify /etc/ld.so.preload.(Citation: ATT TeamTNT Chimaera September 2020)
